## Introducción

`estheRineq` integra la econometría de desigualdades en encuestas complejas (tipo ENDES, ENAHO, DHS o MICS) y la vigilancia epidemiológica de equidad en salud (las 21 medidas de la OMS, `SII`/`RII`, tasas estandarizadas `DSR`/`SMR`, *equiplots* estilo Pelotas y reportes **STROBE-Equity**). Por defecto genera tablas y gráficos en inglés internacional (`lang = "en"`), y permite cambiar cualquier salida a español (`lang = "es"`) o portugués (`lang = "pt"`).

```{r}
library(estheRineq)

svy <- survey_health_data(
  data = survey_mch,
  weights = "sample_weight",
  strata = "stratum_id",
  psu = "cluster_id"
)
```

## 1. Índice de Concentración de Erreygers por Dominio y Prueba de Wald

```{r}
res_ci <- concentration_index(
  svy,
  outcome = "stunting",
  rank = "wealth_score",
  method = "erreygers",
  by = "area",
  favorable = FALSE
)
print(res_ci, lang = "es")
```

## 2. Índices `SII` y `RII` y Gráficos *Equiplot*

```{r}
res_sii <- sii_rii(
  svy,
  outcome = "full_immunization",
  rank = "wealth_quintile",
  favorable = TRUE,
  scale = 100
)
print(res_sii, lang = "es")
```

```{r}
equiplot(
  svy,
  outcome = "full_immunization",
  subgroup = "wealth_quintile",
  by = "region",
  scale = 100,
  diagnose_pattern = TRUE,
  sort_by = "gap",
  lang = "es"
)
```

## 3. Estandarización Directa Distrital y Gráfico de Embudo (*Funnel Plot*)

```{r}
dsr <- direct_standardize(
  district_mortality,
  events = "deaths",
  population = "population",
  stratum = "age_group",
  group = "district",
  standard_pop = "who_broad_5"
)
funnel_plot(dsr, lang = "es")
```
